name: Doro Wat
description: A rich and spicy Ethiopian chicken stew made with berbere, onions, garlic, and traditional spices, served with injera.

name: Shiro Wat
description: A smooth and flavorful chickpea stew cooked with onions, garlic, berbere, and Ethiopian spices, usually enjoyed with injera.

name: Beef Tibs
description: Tender pieces of beef sautéed with onions, peppers, tomatoes, garlic, and Ethiopian spices for a rich and savory flavor.

name: Kitfo
description: A famous Ethiopian dish made from finely minced beef seasoned with spiced clarified butter and mitmita, traditionally served with ayib and greens.

name: Vegetable Firfir
description: Torn pieces of injera mixed with a flavorful vegetable sauce, onions, tomatoes, and Ethiopian spices for a comforting vegetarian meal.

name: Fasting Bayaynet
description: A colorful combination of vegetarian Ethiopian dishes such as lentils, vegetables, and spicy sauces served together on injera.

name: Sambusa
description: Crispy pastry filled with seasoned lentils, onions, and spices, making it a popular Ethiopian snack or starter.

name: Ethiopian Coffee
description: Freshly roasted and brewed Ethiopian coffee with a rich aroma and bold flavor, traditionally prepared and served in small cups.
